scopeAndLimitations: Contracts, endpoint, request and rules are synthetic teaching examples.
Only simplified JSON request-object required-field changes and one specified old request were checked.
A local validator rejection is not an observed HTTP response or proof of production service behavior.
Response fields, type narrowing, enums, formats, authentication, defaults, status-code semantics and full OpenAPI compatibility were not analyzed.
One accepted request does not prove that all old clients remain compatible.
This delegated review is not a complete product-host automatic skill-routing test.
No claim is made about general accuracy improvement or routing reliability across all hosts.
